chunks: Every soul has to know the taste of death. You will then be sent back to Us.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the inevitability of death and return to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of death as a divine decree that purifies the soul, preparing it for the ultimate return (ruju') to Allah for accountability. It highlights the transient nature of worldly life, urging believers to focus on eternal deeds rather than temporary pleasures, a concept deeply rooted in the Imams' teachings on preparing for the Hereafter.
